title: Maqbool
favouriteScene: The bloodstain on the floor that Maqbool frantically scrubs, echoing Lady Macbeth's guilt in a sea-facing Mumbai apartment.
favouritePerformance: Pankaj Kapur as Abbaji & Irrfan Khan as Maqbool & Naseeruddin Shah as Inspector Purohit
personalReflections: Adapting Macbeth into the Mumbai underworld with profound psychological weight. The supernatural witches transformed into corrupt astrology-obsessed police officers is pure genius.
